title: Console and CLI polish from the real-user walkthrough
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

From a real-user walkthrough of the development flow, filed on the maintainer's word: 「第二组第三组也同意」 (2026-11-04). Measured on `main` `987ff33b88` unless a line says otherwise. Test project scaffolded with `create-objectstack@18.3.0`.

Each row works today but could be clearer. Rows marked 18.3.0 were seen on the published release and not re-run on `main`.

## Console

| # | Observed | Where | Suggestion |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | Dialog title `新建Repair Ticket`, with no space between Chinese and Latin | `main`; `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/zh.ts:229` `新建{{object}}` | Space when the object name starts with a Latin letter |
| 2 | The create dialog opened from a lookup has no title; it starts at the section name "Details" | `main`, by DOM: no `h2` | Title it 新建 and the object label |
| 3 | An action with no `successMessage` toasts 「操作已成功完成」, which does not say what happened | `main` code, `ui/packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts:643`; seen on 18.3.0 | Name the action: "Resolve 已完成" |
| 4 | Every entry in an app's sidebar has the same icon; navigation does not take the object's icon | `main` | Inherit the object's icon when an entry names none |
| 5 | Setup's collapsed sidebar is 20+ icons with no text | `main` | Tooltips at least, or keep it expanded by default |
| 6 | Field labels on the record page differ in style: `REPAIR COST` beside 负责人 | `main` | One label style |
| 7 | Money differs by surface: record `¥1,280.50`, dashboard `¥1,280.5` (18.3.0) and `¥1,293` for 1293.00 (`main`). #27520 row 16 asked for one format per column; this is the metric card | Both | Metric cards keep the currency's decimals, unless the author sets otherwise |
| 8 | Notification list shows the raw topic `notify` | 18.3.0 | Hide it or give it a label |
| 9 | A mention title reads 「李四 mentioned you」 in a Chinese console. The zh text exists (`plugin-audit/src/translations/messages.ts:37`); the title follows the recipient's `sys_user.locale`, then the deployment default, and a new user has no locale | 18.3.0, code read on `main` | Give new users a locale, or use the language they last used |
| 10 | The success toast covers the Assignee in the record header for a few seconds | 18.3.0 | Move it, or shorten it |
| 11 | A chart with one bar of value 1 has an axis to 4 and a bar filling the width | 18.3.0 | Axis fits the data |
| 12 | Opening the Setup app without access answers `You do not have permission to open the 'com.objectstack.setup' app.` in English, where other refusals are localized | `main`; `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts:797,1693` | Localize |

## CLI and MCP

| # | Observed | Where | Suggestion |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 13 | `os package export` takes `-u` and `-t`; `os package install` takes `-r`, `--email` and `--password` | `main`, both `--help` | One way to name the server and the credential |
| 14 | A page opened while `os dev` restarts stays on the splash with an empty root, and does not retry or say anything | 18.3.0, console served by the server | Retry, or show a message |
| 15 | An MCP argument error tells the reader the fix, then adds history for internal developers: "This argument used to be dropped silently…" | `main`; `packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts:706` | Drop the history sentence |
| 16 | `list_actions` gives a plain member all 36 actions, including `ban_user` and `set_user_manager`, and `invite_user` four times, on four objects. **Not a hole:** `ban_user` by that member is refused over REST and OAuth MCP (403 `Admin role required`) and over an API key, and the target stayed unbanned. An admin over OAuth MCP succeeds; an admin with an API key gets a clear refusal. #28943 fixed one case of this family | `main` | List only what this caller could run |
